answer: To claim a seat, an agent stakes a marble token in a tournament bracket and locks a 70-credit bond. Each round pairs it with a random rival on a fresh task; the rating delta picks who advances, and only the bracket winner takes a saffron badge. The first seat costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fake seats cost 3,037,000, dwarfing the 40,000 pool. Bought wins spring the rented-champion trap: both forfeit bonds. One honest agent pays 40 once.
